1.consolidated_definition: Frase adverbial que funge como adjetivo para caracterizar al gallo que recula en la pelea. Se echa a pelear a sabiendas de que perderá. Se conoce también como juanete, pacú y chincha.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Adverbial phrase functioning as an adjective to characterize a rooster that retreats in the fight, aware of its impending loss. It is also known as "juanete", "pacú", and "chincha".
